description: This file defines a Java class 'ThingQuerySignalMapper' that extends 'AbstractQuerySignalMapper' for mapping thing query signals in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for constructing topic paths and enhancing payloads based on 'ThingQueryCommand' objects.

classes.name: ThingQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps thing query signals, extending the abstract query signal mapper for specific command type 'ThingQueryCommand'.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs the topic path for the given 'ThingQueryCommand' by creating a new topic path builder with the entity ID and appending 'things()'.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with the selected fields from the 'ThingQueryCommand' if present.
